about: The makeyourmindup intro sting: 56 frames at 30 fps in front of every 16:9 long cut of a weekly series piece, and nowhere else (Krish, 2026-11-05). The 9:16 short cut opens straight on the hook (house rule HOOK_IS_THE_INTRO). The sting is the clips Krish saw on the Intro Sting page, byte for byte: its Remotion source was never committed and is lost, so the clips are the design. They live in the library at clips.<shape>.<series>.library, and every machine that renders gets them with python scripts/quick-edit/intro.py fetch, checked by size and sha256. Off-day pieces wear no sting.

seen.label: Second direction
seen.how: Each clip was taken byte for byte from the page Krish looked at; its sha256 here is the clip he saw. The 9:16 clips are kept for the record and used nowhere: shapes says where the sting goes.

placement.words: I think it should go at the start of the longer wide videos 100%,
placement.means: The 16:9 long cut opens on the sting, then the hook, with his face on the very next frame after the sting's last; the 9:16 short cut opens straight on the hook.

colours.picked: Keep it as I saw it
colours.means: Asked whether each series' sting may flash the other series' colours on its way to its own colour and the wordmark, he picked the option to keep it as he saw it. This is the one written exception to the series-colour rule (scripts/pages/brand.py series_look): the brand intro on a weekly series piece's wide cut.
